text:
Arjun: FYI rolled the seq-throttle + soft-evict combo to a 5% canary at 08:00. quick TL;DR: p50 -6%, p95 -18%, p99 -31%, token-cost -9%. dashboard has histogram + per-model split.
Sasha: nice. this is the soft-evict change that frees KV on high-pressure keys, right?
Arjun: exactly. two parts: (1) seq-aware throttle that keeps microbatch sizes stable, (2) soft-evict that trims LRU prefixes when KV > 82%. reduces tail stalls when a few long sequences arrive.
Mira: numbers from the 2.5h canary window:
```
baseline p50: 120ms -> canary: 113ms (-5.8%)
baseline p95: 420ms -> canary: 344ms (-18.1%)
baseline p99: 1120ms -> canary: 772ms (-31.1%)
tokens/sec per GPU +9.4%
cost per 1M tokens: -9.0%
error rate: 0.028% -> 0.030% (within noise)
OOM events: 0 -> 0
```
Arjun: no increase in 5xxs; one transient spike in one AZ for 3m — ops-bot auto-healed a node.
ops-bot: auto-remediation triggered for worker-az-b; replaced instance at 2025-01-11T08:12:11Z. overall canary health: nominal.
Sasha: rollout plan? gate conditions?
Arjun: ramp 5% -> 25% in 6h -> 75% in 24h -> 100% in 36h if no regressions. rollback triggers: p99 +12% absolute vs baseline OR error rate x4 sustained 10m. deploy-bot will run synthetic probes every 60s.
deploy-bot: seq-throttle-canary deployed @ 2025-01-11T08:00:00Z (5% traffic). synthetic probe schedule started.
Mira: model-level impact: tiny models (L1/L2) see largest p99 drops; L5 shows ~8% p99 improvement but larger batching already mitigates tail there.
Sasha: any quality diff? throttling should be transparent but confirm.
Arjun: ran 1k A/B pairs across 8 workloads. eval harness reports no statistically significant output drift (p>0.1 on perplexity/ROUGE). gist attached in dashboard.
Mira: I'll add notes to the Optimize playbook: recommend Dedicated customers consider earlier opt-in if they have many short-seq workloads. also add config knobs for KV threshold and soft-evict aggressiveness.
Sasha: :thumbsup: can you add a short blurb for the weekly runtime wins channel?
Arjun: will post summary + grafana links after the 25% step. Cheers.
__notes: Internal runtime announcement: seq-throttle + soft-evict canary rollout. Contains short Slack-style messages, metrics in a code block, bot messages, rollout plan, and evaluation notes. All fields are strings or lists of strings per agents.md schema.
